scope: Exact original PNG-oracle body RGBA over proven matched white strips at narrow100/150, strict untransformed pixels and only coverage-eligible transformed constant plateaus. The first all-white/missing shadow fails before cache metadata; any nonwhite exact RGBA disagreements accumulate across all cases and still fail the final zero-mismatch requirement after persisting diagnostics. Real CSV chooser, Compact ribbon, scale, Collapse/reopen/Dismiss and one-step outer scroll retain source/pages/model/history with zero jobs. Actual cache metadata proves two uploads and reuse through resize/scroll/visibility/idle. Wide expanded/reopened absence compares exact SHA at identical actual-body coordinates against the dismissed canvas, requiring a white-background witness while retaining ordinary gridlines. The24-unit samples exclude the inside border and scrollbar; excluded pane-adjacent pixels remain diagnostic samples. Wide retained-versus-dismissed SHA compares identical coordinates chosen from the actual retained body, never its moving scrollbar. Narrow positive oracle and retained probes are unchanged. Retained/dismissed absence is checked; exiting frames, top/bottom corner parity, physical input and all-scale GPU precision remain outside this focused gate. No canonical-model rounding exception, fitted colors, clipboard or report upload.
curation: Pixel RGBA arrays and excluded per-pixel coordinate lists omitted. Original full JSON hashes in originals.json; exact expected band colors, eligible/excluded counts, source/frame hashes, coverage mapping and matched-background witness summaries retained.
